description: This Java class implements the MessageSourceService interface, providing functionality to load and access message properties, primarily from 'messages.properties', before the Spring context is initialized. It uses a singleton pattern for instantiation and includes methods for retrieving messages and managing message sources.

classes.name: DefaultMessageSourceServiceImpl
classes.description: Implements message source loading and retrieval for the OpenMRS platform, using a singleton pattern.
